title: The Street
caption: A suburb's street at night. Snow.

hour.means: the time of night: 0.9 night … 0.95 late night (the script sets late)

late.means: the weight of the look “late night” — the script sets it by hour

beat.means: the film's beat: the game sets a name — the beat plays from its beginning (the module beats)

beat_next.means: which beat comes next: the scene makes its first frame ready, the cut goes to the ready one

knock.means: “Windows”: N — Busygin goes to the window winN and knocks (knock:hit, knock:done); 0 — goes back to Silva

vyodra.means: “Buckets”: fill — to the barrel, a full bucket (vyodra:full); throw — carries it to the shed, throws the water (vyodra:splash); none — puts the bucket down

run.means: “Running”: where Busygin is to run, from the gate (0) to the path to the platform (1), ≈ 65 m

run_at.means: “Running”: where he is now (the scene sets it, 10 times a second)

look_back.means: “Running”: 1 — he stands and looks back at the kitchen window

splash.means: water on the shed: each change — a splash (the scene sets it)

win1.means: window 1: 0 dark · 1 lit · 2 lit, a silhouette in it

win2.means: window 2: 0 dark · 1 lit · 2 lit, a silhouette in it

win3.means: window 3: 0 dark · 1 lit · 2 lit, a silhouette in it

win4.means: window 4: 0 dark · 1 lit · 2 lit, a silhouette in it

win5.means: window 5: 0 dark · 1 lit · 2 lit, a silhouette in it

mak_window.means: Makarskaya's window: 0 dark · 1 lit · 2 lit, a silhouette in it

win1_lit.means: the light of the window win1 — the script sets it by win1

win1_who.means: the silhouette in the window win1 — the script sets it by win1

win2_lit.means: the light of the window win2 — the script sets it by win2

win2_who.means: the silhouette in the window win2 — the script sets it by win2

win5_lit.means: the light of the window win5 — the script sets it by win5

win5_who.means: the silhouette in the window win5 — the script sets it by win5

mak_window_lit.means: the light of the window mak_window — the script sets it by mak_window

mak_window_who.means: the silhouette in the window mak_window — the script sets it by mak_window

porch_light.means: the bulb over the Sarafanovs' porch

door.means: the Sarafanovs' door: 0 shut … 1 open inward

door_f.means: the turn of the Sarafanovs' door, degrees — the script sets it by door

mak_door_f.means: the turn of Makarskaya's door — the script sets it by mak_door

nb_door.means: the neighbours' door (the house next to the Sarafanovs'): 0 shut … 1 open

nb_door_f.means: the turn of the neighbours' door — the script sets it by nb_door

fire.means: the fire in the shed: light in its little window, tongues under the roof, smoke, orange light on the snow (the game moves it in “Buckets”)

steam.means: steam over the shed put out

shed_burnt.means: the shed after the fire (the beat after_fire sets it): 1 — scorched/burnt out by shed_left

shed_left.means: the shed after the fire: 1 — it stood (the roof whole), 0 — burnt out (black walls with no roof); the game sets it before after_fire

silva_smoke.means: smoke from Silva's sleeve (the beat fire sets it, puts it out over 30 s)

shawl.means: the insert “The Coat” (closeups, the shot shawl): 0 shut, 1 open

lay.means: “The Coat”: the coat comes down on her shoulders (the game moves it; only the insert's animate reads it)

warm.means: a key of the play: the kitchen window's light and the patch on the snow (0.55 + 0.45·warm)

frost.means: a key of the play: frost on the kitchen window, from the corners to the middle

nina_is.means: a key of the play: Nina knows the truth / as a sister / no — porch_night, porch_after

secret.means: a key of the play: the secret of the orchestra (L115 on the porch — the game says it)

silva_door.means: a key of the play: Silva runs out ahead in run_out

ending.means: a key of the play: who is in the kitchen window in night_window

nina_end.means: a key of the play: Nina in the window in night_window, or she is not

nina_for.means: a key of the play: Nina alone stands at the window in night_window (at saturday/suitcase)

knocked.means: a key of the play: the numbers of the windows he knocked at in I (''…'12345'): in evening they are dark

prompts.text: Very quiet low drone of wind along an empty village street at night, sparse, cold
Soft sustained string pad, almost still, tender and aching, winter night, minor key
Distant dogs and snow hush rendered as soft ambient noise, no melody
Slow solo piano, few notes, lots of silence, Soviet film score, melancholic
Glassy high harmonics like frost on a window, shimmering, very slow
Warm low organ hum like a lit window in the cold, very soft
Muted felt piano lullaby, warm and sad, 1970s Russian chamber music
Cello long notes, quiet, breathing, intimate, late night
Gentle accordion far away behind a wall, provincial suburb, nostalgic
Minimal ambient with soft bell-like tones, cold and still
Slow guitar arpeggios, sparse, lonely road at night, restrained
Celesta and strings, a winter tale but sad, very slow
Soft brushed snare and double bass, slow night jazz muffled by snow
Solemn wordless choir hum, far away, cold air
Tense quiet pulse, someone waiting outside a door
Faint ticking texture and warm chord, a kitchen seen from the street
